value.rationale: A sharp minimal counterexample identifies the smallest number of graph vertices where a full combinatorial face-count profile fails to determine the Euclidean Gaussian sampling invariant within tree graph associahedra. All 8-node candidates are classified by unique repeated vertex count; the exact gap is nonzero. This is a natural structural boundary, not an arbitrarily chosen finite datum.
